scope: 31-entry follow-up: 17 catalog entries VERIFIED and activated; A New Dawn partial repair active but NOT VERIFIED; 13 unresolved. Six earlier proc-batch entries also activated and VERIFIED, for 23 total promotions.

entries.name: Molten Shields
entries.reason: Ward-school-specific reflection window must be set from the ward cast; generic proc would not configure reflection school.

entries.name: Flame Throwing
entries.reason: Periodic readiness now respects its cooldown and existing ready buff; one-use Fireball spellmod consumption starts the native cooldown.

entries.name: Frost Channeling
entries.reason: Exact killing-spell context checks Frost damage, direct player ownership, reward permission and XP/honor target eligibility; restores mana once through native 812520.

entries.name: Improved Bloodrage
entries.reason: Defensive Stance condition, damage-reduction value and capstone Stagger clearing require linked custom logic.

entries.name: Commanding Presence
entries.reason: Both ranks select Battle/Commanding helper; native per-level stats; correct helper duration to 10 minutes.

entries.name: Copious Power
entries.reason: Triggered buff 965418 has a zero magnitude; must receive rank amount and consume on the next eligible cast-time heal.

entries.name: Reverberation
entries.reason: Three next-different-shock helpers exist, but native damage spellmods can also amplify periodic Flame Shock. Need direct-only application and consumption without a periodic snapshot leak.

entries.name: Tidal Mastery
entries.reason: Direct healing criticals dispatch native Tidal Force extension with 2000/1000/500ms by spell root.

entries.name: Improved Ghost Wolf
entries.reason: Ghost Wolf cast -> native Spirit Dash root/snare dispel and speed; 20-second proc cooldown.

entries.name: Enhancing Totems
entries.reason: Successful cast must have created a matching live totem; custom base points provide rank and level-scaled attack/spell power.

entries.name: Emberstorm
entries.reason: Four allowed cast roots -> native Chaos Bolt cooldown helper; suppress unrelated Wild Felfire branch.

entries.name: Improved Counterattack
entries.reason: Mongoose Bite and Raptor Strike direct critical hits trigger the existing two-second Killer Instinct cooldown reduction, with the visible parent four-second proc cooldown.

entries.name: Improved Blessing of Might
entries.reason: Rank and level-scaled self/ally buffs; native caster-owned single-target aura tracking replaces only that caster's previous ally buff.

entries.name: Sanctified Light
entries.reason: Blinding Light arms the existing critical modifier; one charge and spellmod-required finish consumption limit it to the next affected cast.

entries.name: Raging Berserker
entries.reason: Enabling events and low-health window are identifiable; helper 818502 has no authoritative numeric AP coefficient. Do not invent lifesteal scaling.

entries.name: Improved Execute
entries.reason: Below-20-percent damage doubling and conditional stacking critical bonus must agree; proc-only repair does not cover full tooltip.

entries.name: Improved Berserker Stance
entries.reason: Conditional execute-range/enrage damage multiplier plus Raging Blow/Recklessness duration extension requires custom logic.

entries.name: Unrelenting Storm
entries.reason: Three-stack state must empower Chain Lightning and apply the target vulnerability; generic haste proc is incomplete.

entries.name: Fanaticism
entries.reason: Crusader Strike mark, Execution Sentence-dependent amplification, Judgement movement and PvE cooldown reduction form a multi-event chain.

entries.name: Improved Flash Heal
entries.reason: Flash Heal cast -> native effect 165 reduces Inner Focus by 2 seconds; stale helper text is not its actual target.

entries.name: Void-touched Mind
entries.reason: Helper 833215 actually extends Void Eruption by 3000ms despite stale Divine Illumination text. Mind Flay stacking and extension ceiling still require an aura-owned lifecycle.

entries.name: Resourcefulness
entries.reason: Three allowed periodic damage roots -> three explicit 1000ms cooldown reductions; 1-second proc cooldown.

entries.name: Spell Power
entries.reason: Critical-damage baseline is zero-valued and must obey highest/nonstacking behavior with existing critical modifiers. Capstone helper also needs explicit 10-second duration and 10% magic plus 5% Arcane values.

entries.name: Netherwind Presence
entries.reason: Seven originating spell roots select rank-specific haste; final-rank Slow requires three haste stacks before granting movement speed.

entries.name: Improved Earth Shield
entries.reason: Original-caster healing proc requires final Tidal Waves, permits triggered healing and observes a five-second cooldown.

entries.name: Booming Echoes
entries.reason: Direct shock hit selects Nature/Fire/Frost helper; periodic ticks excluded.

entries.name: Improved Feral Spirit
entries.reason: Spirit Walk owner/pet relationship, rank-dependent dispel chance and both wolves Stormstrike empowerment must be linked.

entries.name: Wind Rush
entries.reason: Wind Shear successful-interrupt hook only, capstone required, once per cast.

entries.name: Combat Readiness
entries.reason: Taking eligible hits must refresh the defensive stack and enforce the ten-second inactivity expiry, not just add a proc.

entries.name: A New Dawn
entries.reason: Light of Dawn applies caster-owned marks; eligible healing consumes the original caster's mark. Native damage modifier interpretation is excluded for Area 52. Baseline all-ability critical chance still needs review before VERIFIED.

entries.name: Wind Rush
entries.reason: Same Wind Rush implementation; duplicate catalog entry.

publication: Activation and local client installation complete; source/client release/Discord publication tracked separately.
